entities.summary: Diana Stein is a multidisciplinary theatre artist, working as a director, playwright, scenographer, lyricist, and performer. She integrates stage direction, set design, and dramatic writing in her productions. Over the years, she has been involved in experimental theatre and collaborated with major national institutions, including the Ivan Franko National Academic Drama Theatre, the Taras Shevchenko Dnipro National Academic Ukrainian Music and Drama Theatre, and the Les Kurbas National Centre for Theatre Arts.
